title: haaye zainab
body:
haaye zainab
(Haay Hussain, Haay haay Hussain) x3
<<MINI>>
(Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Jal gaye hai, sare khayme) x2
Al-kamaa khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. (Chin gayi sar se hai chadar, Kya kare binte ali) x2
(Us taraf darya kanare) x2
Ba waffa khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. (Agayi shame ghariba, Ho gayi kaydi haram) x2
(Aab le paawoo ke rowe) x2
raasta khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. (Ab kaha zainab ko chain, Aayenga akber ke bagair) x2
(kha ke barchi akbare) x2
Gulbul ka baa khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. (Kaise guzrengi rasan, Ab kya kare maktal bahan) x2
(be kafan bhayi hai ran mai) x2
be rida khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. (Rukchuki Zainab bhare, gar ko sare karbobela) x2
Karbobala se shame tak) x2
Sare fazaa khamosh hai
<<MINI>>
Haaye Zainab rorahee hai, Karbela khamosh hai) x2
